title: Notifications
description: Phone-to-Mac notification mirror (capability notifications). notif-post pushes one notification; notif-dismiss retracts it (sent either direction). Text is truncated by senders (title 128, text 512 chars); receivers enforce the same caps fail-soft. IDs are phone-assigned strings (max 128 chars).

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.2.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

id.description: Phone-assigned notification key; dismiss echoes it.

app.description: Posting app label, e.g. Messages. Optional.

text.description: Notification body (notif-post only). Never logged verbatim server-side.

posted_at.description: Unix seconds when posted on the phone.
